# AlphavantagePF Shiny Functions

This repository collects useful functions which can be added to the  [alphavantagepf](https://derekholmes0.github.io/alphavantagepf/index.html) Shiny Interface.
Many functions are already included in that package, but as the package includes the ability to add new functions (see  [New Functionality Vignette](https://derekholmes0.github.io/alphavantagepf/articles/ShinyApp_4_New_Functionality.html), it is useful to have a place
to store experimental or specialized functions.

This repository does just that.  Use of these functions assumes an existing (and data-populated) instance of the [alphavantagepf](https://derekholmes0.github.io/alphavantagepf/index.html) 
package.

To download these functions, use the following

```
pak::pak("derekholmes0/avpfShinyFuncs")
require(avpfShinyFuncs)
```
To add to the `av_runShiny()` ecosystem prior to , just do the following:

```
require(alphavantagepf)
require(avpfshinyFuncs)
av_load_shinydata();
av_runShiny_addFunctions()
av_runShiny()
```

Alternatively, download the function files into your own user directory, and add that directory to the "User Function Directory"
box on the <span style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: 2px">AVOPTS</span> tab.

## Function List

The following table shows which functions are in which files:

|AV Command|Ready?|File|Description|
|:---------:|:-----:|:--------:|:------------------------|
|RCOR| -- |`Correlations.R`|Rolling Correlation studies|
|OLAST| -- |`eq_opts.r`|Table of Last downloaded options per ticker|
|GPIV|Needs IV surface|`eq_opts.r`|Graph implied volatilities|
|GPIVS|Needs IV Surface|`eq_opts.R`|Graph Implied Volatilite Spreads|
